app-templates.message:
ci: preview the templates on every pull request

## Intent

Make a change to the templates visible, not only checked. Every pull request gets a preview of the built templates, the way the apps already have one.

## Key changes

- A preview workflow builds the quiz, the explainer and the interactive template as apps, with a page that links them.
- The app preview action of lernapps/tooling publishes them on gh-pages at https://lernapps.net/app-templates/pr-preview/pr-<number>/ and links the preview in a comment on the pull request. Closing or merging removes it.
- The preview is built into preview/, because npm ci already builds the runtime package into dist/.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the branch gh-pages and GitHub Pages serving it from its root.

moved.why: Adds the preview environment asked for after the quiz change was done; it serves this request, not the question count.
